_help: Act 2, McKenna's tavern: recruiting Idris Mahjoub (hired_idris). 35; 50 and he sends it home (idris_paid_well, trust +2); 20 and he resents it (idris_underpaid). idris_contacts: he knows the underworld (Act 7). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: idris
already.line: I am ready when you are. The money went home this morning.

first.speaker: idris
first.line: You are looking for guns. I am Idris Mahjoub. I guard merchants on the road south, and none of them has lost a piastre with me.

choices.label: Hire him
choices.line: I need a man who can shoot and keep his head. Interested?

choices.label: Ask about the city
choices.line: Who do you know in this city?

underworld.speaker: idris
underworld.line: Every thief in Cairo sells to someone, and I know most of the someones. If something valuable leaves this city, I can usually find out how.

fee.speaker: idris
fee.line: Thirty-five pounds for the job, paid before we leave. It goes home to my sisters in Omdurman.

choices.label: Pay more for his family
choices.line: Make it fifty. Send it home.

choices.label: Offer less
choices.line: Twenty. Take it or leave it.

joined.speaker: idris
joined.line: Then we have an agreement. I keep my agreements.

joined_well.speaker: idris
joined_well.line: You have bought more than a gun today, my friend.

joined_cool.speaker: idris
joined_cool.line: Twenty. I will remember that this was the price of my life.
